name: plcc-ng Demo
initializeCommand: test -d ../dev || git clone https://github.com/ourPLCC/dev ../dev; git -C ../dev config core.hooksPath .githooks
postCreateCommand: sudo chown vscode:vscode /home/vscode/.claude && npm i -g backlog.md@$(cat /workspaces/dev/.backlog-version) && git -C /workspaces/dev status >/dev/null && git -C ${containerWorkspaceFolder} status >/dev/null && ${containerWorkspaceFolder}/bin/install/claude-imports.bash
